name: CypherMonkey
bio: I like hard problems that I can explain simply. I build free labs about voice, contact centers, and AI so a curious student can try them.
mission: Free learning for anyone who wants to see how calls, contact centers, and AI actually work.
verify: Primary sources come first: official docs, RFCs, and standards bodies. A date on this site is published only after the source page was opened. Counts that I have not checked myself stay out of the copy.
